```yaml
name: Clean Unused Strings
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 1 * *'  # Run monthly on the first day at midnight
  workflow_dispatch:  # Allow manual triggering

jobs:
  clean-unused-strings:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r Tools/requirements.txt

      - name: Detect unused strings
        id: detect
        run: |
          python Tools/detect_unused_strings.py
          echo "unused_count=$(cat /tmp/unused_count.txt)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Remove unused strings
        if: env.unused_count != '0'
        run: |
          python Tools/remove_unused_strings.py

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: env.unused_count != '0'
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: remove unused localization strings" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/cleanup-unused-strings || echo "Push failed"

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: env.unused_count != '0'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: cleanup-unused-strings
          title: "chore: remove unused localization strings"
          body: "This PR removes unused localization strings detected by the automated cleanup workflow."
          commit-message: "chore: remove unused localization strings"
          delete-branch: true
```
